thread:
mina: Heads-up — onboarding 'aether-lite-7b' int4 today. quick smoke found a weird long-context regression on chat-summarize benchmark (drop ~8% ROUGE-L).

andrew: any change in rotary handling? recent changes to rotary normalization landed last week.

mina: I ran isolated forward: int4 vs fp16 logits correlate ~0.96 across first 256 tokens, but beyond 2048 correlation dives to 0.78. suspect kv-cache warmup or rotary phase wrap mismatch.

chao: Do you have tokenizer mapping? last time mismatch between model vocab.json and our token normalization caused sentinel tokens to shift and broke longctx.

mina: tokenizer seems OK. it's basically same BPE as gemma family. Dumped kv cache states — noticed amplitude on evens/odds heads differ more after quant.

model-ci-bot: CI: aether-lite-7b-int4 -> ONBOARD_SMOKE FAILED (regression detected). Ticket created: INF-2143

zara: Could this be headwise rotary scale vs global scale? aether-lite docs mention 'rotary_scale=head_scalar' in their repo. If converter ignored that flag, we'd apply wrong decay.

mina: Good catch — converter log shows rotary_scale absent. The original FP16 weights have attr 'rotary_scale' per-attention block. Our quant converter drops custom attrs.

andrew: We should preserve attention metadata in exporter. In the meantime, can you try reloading fp16 rotary attrs and reapply scale on int4 emulate?

mina: Did that locally; reapplying per-block scale recovers most of the gap — longctx correlation back to 0.94 and ROUGE-L delta <=2%. Seems like rotary_scale was the main culprit.

chao: For triage notes — steps to detect: 1) compare logits correlation across early vs late tokens; 2) dump per-head kv norm after token 2048; 3) check exporter stripped attention attrs; 4) quick fp32 emulation of rotary scaling.

mina: Will add a post-conversion hook to copy over attention attrs into our model manifest and fail onboarding if they are missing. Also adding a smoke eval to run a long-context summarize.

zara: Add to manifest schema: 'attention_meta': {"rotary_scale": "per_block|global|none", "proj_order": "fused|per_head"} — string values encoded in manifest.

andrew: :+1: also add a guide in docs/ for converters to keep custom attrs. Might save future headaches.

mina: Filed PRs: converter fix + manifest schema change + onboarding smoke test. CI link: https://ci.internal/runs/5544

model-ci-bot: PR opened: converter-preserve-attention-meta (#1022)

mina: Thanks team. Will monitor INF-2143 and start a quick sweep of recent onboards for missing 'rotary_scale'.
